Chopard Imperiale Iris Malika Eau de Parfum 100ml is an elegant and sophisticated women’s fragrance built around the soft, powdery beauty of iris. Floral and refined with a warm sensual base, it delivers a luxurious, feminine scent with graceful depth and long-lasting character.

  • Heart Notes: Iris, Jasmine

  • Base Notes: Vetiver, Woody Notes, Musk
